newsitem.title: JAPAN: Recent fall in NCB shares temporary -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Recent fall in NCB shares temporary -- MOF.

text.p: The recent fall in the share price of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd will be temporary, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Friday.
Asked what he thought about the fall in the bank's share price in spite of its announcement of a restructuring plan, Mitsuzuka said he believed that it was a temporary phenomenon.
He said the fall was due to NCB's plan to issue new stocks to boost its capital.
NCB said in its restructuring plan that it would issue new shares to make up for losses of capital from writing off bad loans.
"Whenever there is an announcement of a plan to increase capital, the shares of the company concerned fall temporarily, even if it is a prestigious firm," he said.
He added that the fall in NCB's share price would not disrupt markets.
